title: Shell Canada Limited Engineering Scholarships Program
description: Established in 1997 through the generosity of Shell Canada Limited, these scholarships are granted to two students entering third year and two entering fourth year in each of the following three departments: Mineral Engineering, Chemical Engineering & Applied Chemistry and Mechanical & Industrial Engineering. The awards are granted on the basis on financial need. Academic performance will also be considered. The first awards were granted in the 1998-99 academic year.

title: Paul Cadario Experiential Learning Student Awards In Engineering
description: This award is being given annually to students in the Faculty of Applied Science and Engineering who access experiential learning opportunities offered through the Experiential Learning Commons. It is awarded to students proceeding to Year 3 on the basis of academic merit, financial need and who successfully complete the Preparatory program.

title: MIE Summer Research Award
sponsor: Mechanical and Industrial Engineering Department at UofT
description: Awarded to one of 21 Mechanical and Industrial Engineering undergraduate students engaging in a summer research position.

title: Dean's List Honor
sponsor: Faculty of Applied Sciences and Engineering at UofT
description: Awarded for achieving above a 79.5% average over the academic year.

title: William Dunbar Memorial Scholarship
sponsor: Mechanical and Industrial Engineering Department at UofT
description: Established in 2014 from the estate of the late William Dunbar, this scholarship is awarded to students in any year of the Mechanical Engineering program on the basis of outstanding academic achievement. Recommendation of the chair of the department.

title: University of Toronto Scholar Award
description: The University of Toronto Scholars Program provides recognition to U of T’s outstanding students, at admission. Approximately 700 recipients receive this award across all UofT campuses.

title: Future Business Leaders of America 2023 CNLC Economics Objective Test National Finalist
description: Awarded for placing within the top 20 in the FBLA 2023 Canadian National Leadership Conference Economics Objective Test.
